meta.description: Compute and interpret VCF quality-control metrics (Ti/Tv, het/hom, novel/known, missingness, HWE, contamination, relatedness) with bcftools stats, vcftools, plot-vcfstats, and identity tools (somalier, peddy, KING).

scientific_integrity.detail: All numbers were produced by executing bcftools/vcftools/cyvcf2 on retained or newly generated synthetic fixtures, cross-checked against an independent bcftools-query parse; no DOI/PMID, trial result, or statistic was invented.

practice_boundaries.detail: Outputs stayed at callset/cohort QC (Ti/Tv, missingness, relatedness); no per-patient diagnostic or treatment conclusion was produced anywhere in the 9 executed inputs.

methodological_ground.detail: The Skill still requires ancestry-matched comparison, genotype-level filtering before missingness/HWE, excess-het-only and controls-only HWE filtering, and identity reconciliation before downstream analysis; none of this was touched by the usage-guide trim.

code_usability.detail: examples/vcf_stats.py (byte-identical to the shelf copy) and both cyvcf2 snippets that now live only in usage-guide.md ran successfully across 9 inputs, including two fixtures neither had been run against before.

functional_suitability.note: All promised QC domains are covered and well-matched to the task; the packaged example still labels PASS-or-dot records as PASS and still omits Ts/Tv counts when transversions=0 (both pre-existing, unaffected by this fix).

reliability.note: Empty VCFs, zero-transversion callsets, multiallelic SNPs, missing INFO/AF, and every broader CLI workflow completed deterministically across all 9 inputs; the two known edge-case presentation gaps remain unresolved but do not crash.

performance_context.note: SKILL.md (233 lines) carries the full reference; usage-guide.md (now 106 lines, down from 267) no longer restates it, so an agent loads QC-metric guidance exactly once instead of twice.

agent_usability.note: Decision tables, ordering rules, and command blocks are unchanged and directly actionable; the vcf_stats.py PASS-count label is still inconsistent with the Skill's own documented PASS/dot distinction.

human_usability.note: Trigger language, Quick Start prompts, and the trimmed usage-guide's overview remain natural and example-driven; nothing a human would need to find the Skill was removed.

security.note: No credentials, destructive commands, or dynamic code execution anywhere in SKILL.md, usage-guide.md, or examples/vcf_stats.py; path/VCF validation is still delegated to cyvcf2 rather than validated explicitly.

maintainability.note: The trim removed a real maintainability liability -- usage-guide.md and SKILL.md previously carried two independently-editable copies of the same QC command blocks that could drift; now each fact lives once. The vcf_stats.py print branch still couples Ts/Tv count visibility to a nonzero denominator, capping this below full marks. The tests/ directory remains present but empty.

agent_specific.note: Progressive disclosure is now materially better: usage-guide.md contains only what SKILL.md does not already say (overview, prerequisites, quick start, the two delegated cyvcf2 snippets, tips, related skills). The custom script's output contract could still be more explicit.

key_strengths: The usage-guide.md duplication trim (267 -> 106 lines) removed a real maintainability liability -- two independently-editable copies of the same QC command blocks -- without dropping anything an agent needs; every removed section was independently confirmed still present in SKILL.md.

The two cyvcf2 snippets that now live only in usage-guide.md are unchanged (confirmed by diffing the fix commit) and were independently re-verified: the per-sample genotype-distribution counts matched an independent bcftools-query parse exactly, and the allele-frequency snippet degrades gracefully instead of crashing when INFO/AF is absent.

The Skill's methodologically sound, context-dependent QC guidance (ancestry-matched comparisons, order-of-operations for filtering before missingness/HWE, excess-het-only and controls-only HWE, identity reconciliation before analysis) is entirely untouched by this fix.

9/9 inputs executed against real tool output (bcftools 1.24, vcftools 0.1.17, cyvcf2 0.31.4), including 2 new inputs never run in a prior audit of this Skill, with 35/38 assertions passing and no crash on any input.

recommendations.title: Separate strict PASS from unfiltered records in the example
recommendations.problem: examples/vcf_stats.py increments 'pass' whenever cyvcf2 exposes FILTER as None, which includes both strict PASS and the unfiltered dot state, then prints the combined count as 'PASS variants'.
recommendations.root_cause: The output contract uses one counter for two VCF FILTER states even though SKILL.md itself correctly distinguishes them (Quick counts section).
recommendations.fix: Report strict PASS and unfiltered-dot records as separate counters, or rename the current count to 'Not-failed variants (PASS or dot)' and add a real strict-PASS counter using variant.FILTER == None and a separate raw-FILTER check. Unchanged from the 2026-09-25 finding; still open.

recommendations.title: Report Ti/Tv components when the transversion denominator is zero
recommendations.problem: When a valid callset has transitions but zero transversions, examples/vcf_stats.py suppresses both component counts because the entire print block is guarded by transversions > 0.
recommendations.root_cause: Presentation of the counts is coupled to whether the ratio has a nonzero denominator.
recommendations.fix: Always print transition and transversion counts; print Ti/Tv as undefined/infinite with an explicit zero-denominator note when transversions are zero. Unchanged from the 2026-09-25 finding; still open.

recommendations.title: Document that the AF-spectrum snippet only bins the first ALT's frequency
recommendations.problem: usage-guide.md's allele-frequency spectrum snippet takes af[0] for any multiallelic record's AF tuple with no comment; a multiallelic site's second and later alternate alleles are silently dropped from the spectrum.
recommendations.root_cause: The snippet was written for the common biallelic case and never annotated for the multiallelic branch it already contains (isinstance(af, tuple)).
recommendations.fix: Add a one-line comment above the isinstance check noting that only the first ALT's AF is binned for multiallelic sites, mirroring the multiallelic caveat already present in SKILL.md's het allele-balance one-liner.
